record.title: Cybersecurity Standard Practice Guide — Security Guidelines for the Deployment and Use of Agents
record.original_title: 网络安全标准实践指南——智能体部署使用安全指引
record.issuing_body: National Cybersecurity Standardization Technical Committee (TC260) Secretariat
record.summary: TC260 practice guide on the security of deploying and using agents: large-model-based AI agents for personal-assistant use that need high user permissions. For the assessment, preparation, deployment, use and decommissioning stages it advises against unmaintained projects and agents that open public interfaces automatically, and calls for installation materials from official channels, a separate device or isolated environment, large models that have completed generative AI service filing, no administrator rights, limited directories and network exposure, full logging, a high-risk operations list with second confirmation or blocking, and emergency stop.
record.notes: Version v1.0-202607, released with notice 网安秘字〔2026〕80号 of 1 July 2026. It can also guide the choice of commercial agent services. High-risk operations include stopping system services, formatting disks, bulk deletion, changing permissions, keys or firewall rules and accessing password managers, and may include transfers and payments. Annex A is a security checklist; Annex B gives organisations management guidance: an internal agent-use policy with prohibited behaviour and approval steps, an agent asset register, logging and risk analysis of agent activity, and discovery of unapproved agents on internal networks.

verification.note: Stored from tc260.org.cn: the guide's PDF (version v1.0-202607) and the release notice 网安秘字〔2026〕80号 (HTML, rendered copy and print). Title, number, issuer, date and contents are confirmed from these; the summary follows the Chinese text. No English version was found. The notice copy is flagged for review because the page has little readable text; the notice text itself is complete.

judgment.status_reasoning: The TC260 Secretariat released the guide with notice 网安秘字〔2026〕80号 (关于发布 ... 的通知, a release notice, not a call for comments); the cover carries the guide's number and a released version (v1.0-202607) with no draft marking (征求意见稿). The preface describes practice guides as technical documents the TC260 Secretariat drafts and publishes to give practical guidance, so it is not binding; no later version is stored. Published (non-binding, current).
